presets.name: Pump
presets.description: The classic sidechain pump: straight down, a slow swell back

presets.name: Quick
presets.description: A short dip that clears room for the kick and gets out of the way

presets.name: Smooth
presets.description: A gentle, rounded duck for pads and vocals

presets.name: Gate
presets.description: Off on the hit, back hard at the end: a choppy trance gate

presets.name: Acid squelch
presets.description: A resonant 24 dB low-pass just short of whistling, driven

presets.name: Warm low-pass
presets.description: A gentle 24 dB roll-off that rounds off the top

presets.name: Self-oscillation
presets.description: Resonance past the edge: the filter sings a sine at its cutoff

presets.name: Fat drive
presets.description: Pushed hard into the transistors: a warm, filtered distortion

presets.name: Thin band
presets.description: A 12 dB band-pass with some ring: telephone-ish and vocal

presets.name: Airy high-pass
presets.description: A 12 dB high-pass with a small peak: clears the lows, keeps the sparkle

presets.name: Analog warmth
presets.description: A low-pass whose resonance saturates like an OTA

presets.name: Screaming band
presets.description: A tight band-pass driven until its peak screams

presets.name: Diode growl
presets.description: Lopsided diode saturation in a resonant low-pass

presets.name: Folded metal
presets.description: The fold shape in the loop: clangy, metallic overtones

presets.name: Hard notch
presets.description: A notch whose hard-clipped loop chews the signal around it

presets.name: Clean all-pass
presets.description: No distortion: an all-pass that shifts the phase around 1 kHz

presets.name: Metallic
presets.description: Strong positive feedback at a fixed pitch: a ringing tube

presets.name: Hollow
presets.description: Negative feedback: odd harmonics only, a clarinet-like hollow

presets.name: Flange static
presets.description: No feedback: the frozen notches of a flanger

presets.name: Tuned A
presets.description: Tuned to the note A2 with a long, soft ring

presets.name: Wide comb
presets.description: Right polarity flipped and spread: wide yet mono-safe

presets.name: Plucked string
presets.description: A string at C3: every harmonic, a medium ring

presets.name: Hollow square
presets.description: Odd harmonics only, like a square wave or a clarinet

presets.name: Glass bell
presets.description: The inharmonic modes of a struck bar: chimes and bells

presets.name: Minor chord
presets.description: A minor chord rings out of anything you feed it

presets.name: Pentatonic wash
presets.description: A pentatonic scale's notes sustain from noise and drums

presets.name: Short body
presets.description: A quick, bright string resonance: body for drums and plucks

presets.name: Ahh
presets.description: The open vowel A

presets.name: Ooh
presets.description: The rounded vowel U

presets.name: Eee
presets.description: The bright vowel I

presets.name: Deep voice
presets.description: O with the formants a fifth down: a big, low throat

presets.name: Small voice
presets.description: E with the formants up: a smaller, higher voice

presets.name: Talk box
presets.description: Between the vowels, narrow and with some of the dry highs

presets.name: Laser zap
presets.description: Many pinched stages up high: transients become a laser chirp

presets.name: Boomy kick
presets.description: The low end smeared into a longer, boomy drop

presets.name: Soft snap
presets.description: A few stages around the mids: a gentler, rounder attack

presets.name: Wet bass
presets.description: A wobbly, liquid bass from a chain around 300 Hz

presets.name: Phasey
presets.description: Half dry: the chain's phase against the dry makes moving notches

presets.name: Bass kill
presets.description: The lows gone: the mixing DJ's swap

presets.name: Mid scoop
presets.description: The mids pulled down for a smiley, club sound

presets.name: Highs only
presets.description: Lows and mids killed: just the hats

presets.name: Warm boost
presets.description: A touch more low end and less top

presets.name: Telephone
presets.description: Only the mids, with a narrow split

presets.name: Brighter
presets.description: Tilted up toward the highs

presets.name: Darker
presets.description: Tilted down toward the highs: warmer, softer

presets.name: Air lift
presets.description: A broad lift above 3 kHz

presets.name: Weight
presets.description: More lows, a little less top, pivoting low

presets.name: Wide sparkle
presets.description: The sides tilted bright: width up top only

presets.name: Smile
presets.description: The classic V: lows and highs up, mids down

presets.name: Vocal presence
presets.description: A lift at 2 to 5 kHz, less mud at 250 Hz

presets.name: Radio
presets.description: Only 300 Hz to 3 kHz: a small speaker

presets.name: Less mud
presets.description: The low mids carved out

presets.name: Sub boost
